subject: Bucketed capacity commit and OEM ETA clarification for LumenAI deal
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michelle Tan <michelle.tan@vectoroem.com>, accounts@cloudnorth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:15:00Z
Subject: Bucketed capacity commit and OEM ETA clarification for LumenAI deal

Hi Michelle / CloudNorth team,

Following our call this morning on LumenAI (DL-9237): they want a guarantee that we can deliver ~8 reserved GPU pods over Q4, but they are open to a phased delivery (4 pods in the first tranche, remaining in a later tranche) if we can provide firm ETAs and pricing.

Questions we need answered from OEM/cloud:
- Can Vector confirm split-shipment support and an ETA window for a first tranche shipped by mid-Oct?
- What are firm lead times per SKU if we submit PO by Aug 20?
- Any MOQ or freight constraints that would force a single shipment?
- Can CloudNorth provide a short-term reserved backfill for the interim (2–6 weeks ramp) and what is the cost delta per token/hour?

We attached the current ask from LumenAI (included in the Drive link) and a rough tranche plan. Primary constraint is the customer wants a signed commitment (and start date) before their board approves the expansion. We need PO lock dates and a clear shipment cadence to draft the mutual action plan.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments referenced: LumenAI_tranche_plan.xlsx (in Drive)

From: Michelle Tan <michelle.tan@vectoroem.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@cloudnorth.com, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Bucketed capacity commit and OEM ETA clarification for LumenAI deal

Ben / team,

Thanks for the clear summary. Vector can support split shipments for the SKUs in question. High-level ETA guidance assuming PO by Aug 20:
- Tranche A (up to 50% of ordered units): 6–8 weeks from PO receipt (target mid-Oct if PO received by Aug 20).
- Tranche B (balance): 12–16 weeks from PO (late-Nov to early-Dec).

Notes / caveats:
- We can hold a "production slot" for you with a non-binding deposit; a full PO is required to lock exact queue position.
- Freight window: domestic shipments are straightforward; international cross-docks may add 1–2 weeks.
- We can accelerate the first tranche by using pre-configured rack units at a modest expedite premium (TBD).

Attached: Vector_OEM_quote_v2.pdf (contains per-tranche pricing and expedite options). Please confirm whether LumenAI accepts the staggered delivery; if so, we'll draft a PO template and hold the production slot for two weeks (until Aug 20).

Best,
Michelle Tan
Head of Sales Operations, Vector OEM

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Michelle Tan <michelle.tan@vectoroem.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Bucketed capacity commit and OEM ETA clarification for LumenAI deal

Quick follow-ups from infra/procurement perspective:
- Cloud fallback: can CloudNorth provide reserved capacity with a 2-week ramp so we can meet LumenAI's start date if the OEM first tranche slips? Need: earliest availability date, cost per hour (or token proxy), and minimum term.
- PO cadence: if Vector needs a PO to lock queue, can we send PO for Tranche A only and commit to Tranche B with a change order? That helps procurement approvals and reduces upfront cash.
- Inventory hold: Michelle, can Vector hold the units at factory/config for a hold period (30 days) if we sign Tranche A PO and push final payment on Tranche B later?

Action: Ben, can you confirm LumenAI's preference on Tranche A PO-only vs. a single PO for both tranches? I can model the cost delta for Cloud backfill once CloudNorth confirms pricing.

karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Procurement & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: CloudNorth Sales <accounts@cloudnorth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T19:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Bucketed capacity commit and OEM ETA clarification for LumenAI deal

Hi Ben / Karthik,

We can provide a short-term reserved backfill for LumenAI while OEM deliverables are staged. High-level offer:
- Reserved pool: up to 4 pods available within 14 days of contract signature.
- Ramp: full reserved capacity within 2 weeks; spot/overflow available sooner if needed.
- Pricing: premium of ~18% above standard reserved rates for the two-week ramp; standard reserved rates apply thereafter.
- Minimum term: 3 months for reserved backfill.

Attached is a term sheet with billing examples and SLOs (cloudnorth-commit-term-sheet.xlsx). We can hold the provisional capacity hold for 7 business days while you finalize OEM PO.

If you want an integrated quote (OEM + CloudNorth blended), we can produce that as a single SKU for the customer's procurement team.

Best regards,
CloudNorth Accounts Team

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michelle Tan <michelle.tan@vectoroem.com>, CloudNorth Sales <accounts@cloudnorth.com>, LumenAI Procurement <buyers@lumena.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T08:02:00Z
Subject: RE: Bucketed capacity commit and OEM ETA clarification for LumenAI deal

Thanks all — concise next steps below (agreed on quick sync 08/12 to finalize):

1) Ben (owner) — confirm with LumenAI whether they accept a two-tranche delivery (Tranche A mid-Oct, Tranche B late-Nov). Need reply by EOD 08/12.
2) Karthik (owner) — prepare PO template for Tranche A only and a change-order template for Tranche B; target to route for signatures by 08/18.
3) Laura (owner) — draft mutual action plan (MAP) that includes the CloudNorth backfill option and the OEM expedite clause; share draft by 08/13.
4) Michelle / Vector — hold production slot pending PO (will hold for two weeks until Aug 20 with deposit option). Provide written confirmation on 30-day factory hold option by 08/13.
5) CloudNorth — hold provisional reserved pool for 7 business days; send formal blended quote if requested.

We'll use the blended quote if LumenAI needs a single procurement line item. If not, we'll sequence Tranche A PO + optional Tranche B change order.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
